categories.main_business_segments: Baotou Dongbao Bio-Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the production and sales of gelatin, collagen protein, hollow capsules, and related derivative products. Its business is divided into B2B segments focusing on pharmaceutical excipients, medical collagen, nutrition, health, medical aesthetics, and new material applications, and B2C segments offering 'Collagen+' series products including nutritional supplements, beauty care, and snacks. The company also has a fertilizer segment producing organic and water-soluble fertilizers enriched with collagen peptides and minerals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced biotechnological methods for extracting and processing natural collagen and gelatin, including patented technologies for plasma-substitute gelatin and modified gelatin products. It has a comprehensive quality management system certified by international standards such as NSF-GMP, FSSC22000, ISO9001, and holds European Pharmacopoeia certifications. The production includes automated hollow capsule manufacturing with proprietary technologies and ongoing R&D in bioactive peptides, modified gelatin for medical applications, and collagen for new materials like textiles and energy sectors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include pharmaceutical companies, health and nutrition product manufacturers, medical aesthetics firms, and new material industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, supplying raw materials like gelatin and capsules to large pharmaceutical groups such as China National Pharmaceutical Group and Guizhou Bailing, as well as health supplement and beauty product companies. The B2C market targets diverse consumer groups with nutritional and beauty products, leveraging e-commerce and retail channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales across East China, North China, Central China, South China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast regions. It also has a growing international presence, with export sales increasing notably. Production facilities and subsidiaries are located in Inner Mongolia and Qingdao, with registered offices in Baotou, Inner Mongolia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Baotou Dongbao Bio-Tech operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the collagen and pharmaceutical excipient supply chain. It produces raw materials like gelatin and collagen protein, manufactures pharmaceutical-grade hollow capsules, and develops end products for health and beauty markets. The company integrates vertically from raw material extraction to finished consumer products, including proprietary branded nutritional supplements.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on innovation in natural collagen extraction, high-value modified gelatin products, and expanding collagen applications into medical, aesthetic, nutritional, and new material fields. R&D priorities include developing low-endotoxin gelatin, antibacterial peptides, bio-protein auxiliaries for textiles, and specialized collagen for industrial applications. It pursues a dual innovation model combining in-house research and external collaborations with academic institutions to enhance product quality and broaden market applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of raw materials (gelatin, collagen protein, capsules) to pharmaceutical and health product manufacturers (B2B), and through direct sales of branded nutritional and beauty products to consumers (B2C) via online and offline channels. The company also earns income from fertilizer sales and receives government subsidies related to assets and innovation projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Baotou Dongbao Bio-Tech is a leading enterprise in the natural collagen industry in China, with a strong market position supported by comprehensive product lines and advanced manufacturing capabilities. It competes with other major gelatin and capsule producers such as Huangshan Capsule and Guangsheng Capsule. The company holds significant influence in industry standards and maintains long-term partnerships with top pharmaceutical groups, reinforcing its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 885 million, a 9.19% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 86 million, down 28.28%. It has total assets of around RMB 2.62 billion and net assets of RMB 1.74 billion. Despite short-term market fluctuations and pricing pressures, the company continues to invest in capacity expansion, digital transformation, and R&D, aiming for sustainable growth and enhanced market competitiveness.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its leadership in natural collagen products with superior quality, comprehensive product portfolio, and integrated industry chain from raw materials to end products. It differentiates through advanced technology, strict quality control certified by international standards, and customized solutions for pharmaceutical and health markets. Its 'Collagen+' branded consumer products leverage natural ingredients and scientific innovation to meet diverse health and beauty needs, positioning it as a trusted national brand in the collagen and health industry.
